summary: @aaranged plus over 1.4 million webmentions sent being powered by microformats as well, and if you count all of the Mastodon users (since every instance includes mf2) the number of use cases seems to be at a high point and growing and not a low point.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @aaranged plus over 1.4 million webmentions sent being powered by microformats as well, and if you count all of the Mastodon users (since every instance includes mf2) the number of use cases seems to be at a high point and growing and not a low point.
